newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Daehan buys 22,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Daehan buys 22,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd bought 22,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat on Friday from Japanese trading house Kanematsu Corp, a company official said.
The official said shipment was set for June 20-July 20 to the western port of Inchon.

The official said the total was split into four positions -- 8,500 tonnes of western white/soft white, 4,000 tonnes of hard red winter (protein minimum 11.5 percent), 1,000 tonnes of hard red winter (protein minimum 13.5 percent), and 8,500 tonnes of dark northern spring (protein minimum 14 percent).
